newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela plans $490 mln bond issue for ID cards.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela plans $490 mln bond issue for ID cards.

text.p: The Venezuelan government is studying options for a $490 million bond issue to raise money for an overhaul of its national identity card system, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said.
Matos told a Congressional committee the issue to pay for the contract with Germany's state-owned mint Bundesdruckerei, would probably be offered on the Eurobond market.
A proposal by Germany's Commerzbank AG had been rejected because it did not reflect the Venezuela's improved credit rating and country risk profile, Matos said.

The government's decision to award the contract to produce high-tech identity cards impossible to forge to the German company, has encountered a lot of opposition in Congress, where legislators complained that they were not consulted and that the contract should have been awarded via an open bidding process.
